name: Improve to Committed
description: Analyzes existing code to produce a structured improvement plan, captures that plan on the board, implements it, and commits -- the improvement-first counterpart to idea-to-committed.
examples: analyze this codebase for improvements, put them on the board, build them, and commit
produce an improvement plan and take it all the way through to a commit
find what should be improved here, break it into tasks, implement them, and commit the work
walk an improvement plan through planning, implementation, and committing
